csv_project_name: A/E for James S. Allen Memorial Park Restrooms Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Van Buren requests qualifications for preliminary architectural services, cost estimate, subsequent design and construction inspection services to assist in a proposed renovation project to be partially financed with FY26 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Community Facility funds. The proposed project consists of replacing the aged restrooms at the James S. Allen Memorial Park, expanding the existing concession stand, and adding ADA improvements.
